invented.quote: The Long Dark Season: Keep the Light Burning
invented.why: The brief does not give a title or subtitle for the game.

invented.quote: The supply boat won't come again until spring.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a supply boat.

invented.quote: The oil has to last, the children have to eat, and ships need the light every night.
invented.why: The brief does not state that the game involves managing oil, feeding children, or lighting the lamp for ships every night.

invented.quote: on an island at the edge of the map
invented.why: The brief does not state that the lighthouse is located on an island.

invented.quote: Each turn you decide what gets done today and what has to wait: fixing the lamp, rationing the stores, caring for someone who's sick, or going out in the storm.
invented.why: The brief does not describe the turn structure, daily actions, or specific tasks like fixing the lamp, rationing stores, caring for the sick, or going out in storms.

invented.quote: No two winters play out the same, and the hardest choices often have nothing to do with the light.
invented.why: The brief does not give details about the game's replayability or the nature of the choices players make.
The brief states there were 140 playtest sessions with about 60 people, not that it was tested at hundreds of tables.

invented.quote: families, first-timers, longtime hobby gamers and solo players.
invented.why: The brief only states that about 60 different people playtested the game, without describing their backgrounds or how they played.
The brief does not state that changes were made after every playtest session.

invented.quote: The rest: platform and payment fees, plus a reserve for freight and surprises
invented.why: The brief does not state how the remaining money in the budget (after manufacturing and shipping to backers) will be spent.

invented.quote: It doesn't include any pay for me.
invented.why: The brief does not state whether the creator is taking any pay from the funding goal.

invented.quote: If we go past the goal, the extra money gives the project a safety margin before any stretch goals.
invented.why: The brief does not mention stretch goals or plans for extra funds raised beyond the goal.

invented.quote: To lower that risk, I locked in the manufacturing quote before launch, budgeted shipping per copy, and built a reserve into the goal.
invented.why: The brief states the creator has a factory quote, not that it is locked in, and does not mention building a reserve into the goal.

invented.quote: This game has been through four winters of playtesting.
invented.why: The brief only says playtesting has run since 2023 and does not state that it has spanned four winters.
